title: Table 2.3b Car parking provisions for development outside of the Perth and Peel regions (minimum spaces per dwelling, R40 and below)

rows.note: studio and 1 bedroom; second column (R50+ 'maximum garage and carport') prints 1

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Value = 'Minimum parking space(s) for R40 and below (per dwelling)'. Ancillary dwelling row: minimum 1 (rule C2.3.3-r1); second column 0 (rule C2.3.3-r3). HEADER PROBLEM: the second column is headed 'Maximum garage and carport parking for R50 and above (per dwelling)' but prints 0/1/1/1, the Part C Location B MINIMUM values, so it reads like a minimum column with a 'maximum' header; no R50+ minimum is stated. Encoded literally in rules C2.3.3-r2 (<= 1) and C2.3.3-r3 (<= 0) with verify true. No Location A/B outside Perth and Peel. C2.9.1(ii) small dwelling parking cites Table 2.3a only, so regional small dwellings have no stated parking requirement.
